y-m-10-05.title: Kutsvaga mapeya edhesimali anowedzera kuita 1
y-m-10-05.topic: Huwandu hwenhamba yedhesimali nenzvimbo imwe nenhamba yedhesimali nenzvimbo mbiri (huwandu nenzvimbo dziri pasi pedhesimali)
y-m-10-05.goal: Sarudza kana kuwedzera nhamba yedhesimali nenzvimbo imwe nenhamba yedhesimali nenzvimbo mbiri kungaita 1, gadzira mapeya enhamba dzedhesimali nenzvimbo mbiri dzinowedzera kuita 1, uye utsanangure kuti pane muenzaniso upi muhuwandu hwenhamba pazvikamu zvega zvega.
y-m-10-05.material: Mubasa iri, 'nhamba yedhesimali nenzvimbo imwe' inhamba ine nhamba imwe mushure medhesimali, se 0.4, uye 'nhamba yedhesimali nenzvimbo mbiri' inhamba ine nhamba yechipiri mushure medhesimali isiri 0, se 0.35. 0.30 yakaenzana ne 0.3, saka inoverengwa senhamba yedhesimali nenzvimbo imwe. Nhamba dzose dzakakura kupfuura 0.
y-m-10-05.thinking.0: Sarudza kutanga kana zvichigoneka kana zvisingagoneki, uye utsvage humbowo
y-m-10-05.thinking.1: Kuparadzanisa miedzo mishoma netsananguro ine hwaro panzvimbo yenhamba
y-m-10-05.thinking.2: Kutsvaga muenzaniso kubva mumienzaniso yakati wandei
y-m-10-05.prereq.0: Nzvimbo dzenhamba dzedhesimali nenzvimbo imwe nenzvimbo mbiri (nhanho yeGiredhi 4)
y-m-10-05.prereq.1: Kuedza kuwedzera madhesimali nokuenzanisa mapoinzi edhesimali
y-m-10-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukawedzera nhamba imwe yedhesimali nenzvimbo imwe nenhamba imwe yedhesimali nenzvimbo mbiri, pane peya inoita 1 chaizvo here?
y-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyorazve nemashoko ako kuti mutemo wakapiwa unoparadzanisa sei 'dhesimali nenzvimbo imwe' ne 'dhesimali nenzvimbo mbiri,' uye utarise nhamba dziri mumakwikwi neiyo mutemo.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza nhamba imwe yedhesimali nenzvimbo imwe nenhamba imwe yedhesimali nenzvimbo mbiri, uiwedzere, uye unyore chete nhamba yechipiri mushure medhesimali muhuwandu.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.o.a: Hapana. Nhamba yechipiri mushure medhesimali yehuwandu yakafanana nenhamba yechipiri mushure medhesimali yenhamba yedhesimali nenzvimbo mbiri, saka haigoni kuva 0
y-m-10-05.s.s1.r.a: Kufunga uku kwakaedza kutsanangura nokutarisa zvakasiyana nhamba iri pazvikamu zvega zvega mushure medhesimali.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.o.b: Pane. Tsvaga peya, se 0.4 ne 0.6, inowedzera kuita 1
y-m-10-05.s.s1.r.b: Verenga mutemo zvakare kuona kana 0.6 i decimal ine decimal place imwe kana mbiri.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.o.c: Iripo. Unogona kuwana peya ine huwandu 1, sa 0.55 ne 0.45
y-m-10-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakawana peya ine huwandu 1, asi tarisa kana nhamba dzose dziri rudzi rumwechete.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.o.d: Kana ndikawedzera mapeya akawanda uye hazvibude, ndinogona kutaura kuti hapana, asi handina kuedza peya yose, saka handina chokwadi
y-m-10-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakatonga kubva pamhedzisiro yekuedza kushoma, asi wakafungawo kuti zvakasimba zvakadini.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.explain: Nhamba ine decimal place imwe ine second decimal place isina chinhu (i 0). Saka second decimal digit yehuwandu i digit yechipiri yenhamba ine decimal places mbiri chete, uye nechibvumirano digit iyoyo haisi 0. Kuti huwandu ive 1 (= 1.00), second place inofanira kuva 0, saka hapana peya yakadaro. Kuedza mapeya akawanda i kutanga kwakanaka, uye kutsanangura ne place value kunobata mamiriro ose kamwe chete.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.acc.0: Wakacherechedza zvakarurama kuti kuedza oga hakugone kuvimbisa 'mamiriro ose'. Kana unogona kutsanangura ne place value, unogona kutaura kuti i chokwadi.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, wana mapeya enhamba mbiri dzine decimal places mbiri dzinowedzera kusvika 1 chaizvo. Nhamba dzose mbiri dzinofanira kuva ne second digit mushure me decimal point isiri 0. Gadzira mapeya matatu akasiyana. (Peya ine nhevedzano yakachinjwa chete i peya imwechete.)
y-m-10-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba imwe pakutanga, uye utarise kuti mutengo waunowana nekuibvisa kubva ku 1 hauna 0 mu second place yawo.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora peya imwe neimwe yawakagadzira yakapatsanurwa kuita first ne second decimal places, uye uenzanise kuti huwandu hwema digits i chii pa place imwe neimwe.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba dzose mbiri dzinofanira kuva dzakakura kupfuura 0.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Nhamba dzose mbiri dzinoenda kusvika pa second decimal place.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Pane madhijiti anopfuura maviri mushure me decimal point (third place kana kupfuura), kana madhijiti haaenderane.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Munhamba dzose mbiri, second decimal digit haisi 0.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Kune nhamba ine second decimal digit i 0 (muenzaniso: 0.4). 0.4 i nhamba ine decimal place imwe.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.explain: Kune mapeya sa 0.35+0.65, 0.12+0.88, ne 0.99+0.01. Nhamba dzine decimal place imwe 0.4 ne 0.6 hadzienderane nechibvumirano ichi. Kana second decimal digit yenhamba imwe i 5, digit yechipiri yenhamba imwe inofanira kuva 5 zvakare (5+5=10).
y-m-10-05.s.s3.prompt: Mumapeya ane huwandu 1, unowana chii kana ukawedzera madhijiti e first decimal place pamwe chete uye madhijiti e second decimal place pamwe chete? Shandisa peya imwe yawakagadzira semuenzaniso uye unyore pattern.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora peya imwe yawakagadzira yakarongwa zvakamira, uye uwedzere madhijiti e first decimal place nemadhijiti e second decimal place zvakaparadzana.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.1: Edza kana mamwe mapeya anopa mitengo yakafanana.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakajeka kuti huwandu hwema first places nehuwandu hwema second places i mitengo yakasiyana here?
y-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaedza kana pattern inoshanda kumapeya asiri peya yawakasarudza here?
y-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatsanangura zvinoitika pa first place kana huwandu hwema second places i 10 here?
y-m-10-05.s.s3.model.0: Madhijiti e first decimal place anowedzera kusvika 9, uye madhijiti e second decimal place anowedzera kusvika 10. Kune 0.35 ne 0.65, i 3+6=9 ne 5+5=10 zvakare.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.model.1: Ma second places anowedzera kusvika 10, saka 1 inotakurwa kuenda ku first place, uye ma first places anowedzera kusvika 9, saka kugamuchira 1 kunoita 10, iyo inotakura 1 yakawanda kupa 1. Ndakatarisa ne 0.12 ne 0.88.

y-m-10-01.title: Musha upi une vanhu vakawanda?
y-m-10-01.topic: Kufananidza nhamba hombe (huwandu hwemadhijiti, wobva wafananidza kubva panzvimbo yepamusoro)
y-m-10-01.goal: Tsanangura kuti hukuru hunosarudzwa sei kana nhamba dziine huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakasiyana, uye kuti dhijiti yenzvimbo ipi inosarudza mhedzisiro kana dziine huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakafanana. Sarudza kuti chii chaunoda kuziva kuti ufananidze kana dhijiti yakavanzwa.
y-m-10-01.material: Unoda kufananidza huwandu hwevanhu vanogara muGaram Village (가람마을) neNarae Village (나래마을). Nhamba dziri pachiratidzo dzose dzinhamba dzechisikwa, dzakanyorwa nekomma (,) mushure memadhijiti matatu ega ega, uye dhijiti yekutanga haisi 0. Chikamu i '명' (vanhu).
y-m-10-01.thinking.1: Tsanangura, uchishandisa mutsara we kana-saka, kuti nei tichifananidza kubva panzvimbo yepamusoro
y-m-10-01.prereq.0: Nzvimbo dzehuwandu nekuverenga nhamba hombe kusvika kumamirioni (chiyero cheGiredhi rechi4)
y-m-10-01.prereq.1: Kuverenga nhamba dzakanyorwa nekomma mushure memadhijiti matatu ega ega
y-m-10-01.s.s1.prompt: Tanga, nyaya apo madhijiti ose anoonekwa. Garam Village ine vanhu 987,654 (mazana mapfumbamwe makumi masere nemanomwe zviuru mazana matanhatu makumi mashanu nemana) uye Narae Village ine vanhu 1,000,000 (mamirioni imwe). Musha upi une vanhu vakawanda?
y-m-10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga madhijiti kuti nhamba imwe neimwe ine madhijiti mangani.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti unofanira kuwedzera zvakadii ku987,654 kuti uwane 1,000,000, uye utarise musiyano pakati penhamba mbiri.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.a: Garam Village. Madhijiti makuru seye 9, 8, 7 anouya kutanga, saka yakakura
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakatarisa kuti madhijiti ekutanga akakura zvakadii. Tarisa kana nzira imwe chete ichishanda kana nhamba mbiri dzine huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakafanana nekana hwakasiyana.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.b: Narae Village. Garam Village ine nhamba yemadhijiti matanhatu uye Narae Village ine nhamba yemadhijiti manomwe
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.b: Iyi ipfungwa yekutanga kuverenga huwandu hwemadhijiti, pane kutarisa dhijiti imwe neimwe.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.c: Hazvigoni kusarudzwa. Maboka akaparadzaniswa nemakomma akasiyana muhuwandu, saka haagoni kufananidzwa
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti nhamba hadzigoni kufananidzwa kana maboka emakomma akasiyana. Makomma zviratidzo zvinoita kuti nhamba dzive nyore kuverenga chete. Funga kuti chii chinosarudza hukuru hwenhamba.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.explain: Kunhamba dzechisikwa dzine dhijiti yekutanga isiri 0, ine madhijiti akawanda ndiyo huru. 987,654 inhamba yemadhijiti matanhatu uye 1,000,000 inhamba yemadhijiti manomwe. Kunyange madhijiti ekutanga 9, 8, 7 achiita akakura, hazvibatsiri. Unogona kuongororawo izvi nokuti kuwedzera 12,346 ku987,654 kunopa 1,000,000.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino chiratidzo chakagwamba. Garam Village ine vanhu 3,□45,678 (□ idhijiti imwe yakavanzwa munzvimbo yehundred-thousands), uye Narae Village ine vanhu 3,500,000 (mamirioni matatu zviuru mazana mashanu). Unoda kuziva chii kuti usarudze kuti musha upi une vanhu vakawanda?
y-m-10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora nhamba mbiri padivi nedivi, nzvimbo imwe nenguva kubva panzvimbo yepamusoro, uye utsvage nzvimbo yekutanga apo madhijiti akasiyana.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kuisa 0 ne9 mu □ uye utarise kana kuti musha upi une vanhu vakawanda kunochinja.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.a: Nhamba yeGaram Village ine 45,678 muchikamu chekumashure uye Narae Village ine 00,000 muchikamu chekumashure, saka Garam Village ine vakawanda kunyange tisingazivi □
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.a: Wakafananidza nhamba nezvikamu zvazvo zvekumashure. Kana madhijiti ekumberi akasiyana munzvimbo imwe chete, zvikamu zvekumashure hazvikanganisi mhedzisiro. Isa 0 mu □ uye ufananidze zvakananga.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.b: Unogona kusarudza chete kana uchiziva chaizvo kuti □ i chii
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.b: Wakafunga kuti unofanira kuziva kukosha chaiko kwe □. Edza kuisa madhijiti mashoma mu □ kuedza kana kuziva range chete kwakakwana kufananidza.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.c: Kuziva chete kana □ i4 kana pazasi, kana i5 kana kupfuura, kwakakwana kusarudza
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.c: Wakawana muganhu apo mhedzisiro yekufananidza inochinja, uye wakatsanangura ruzivo runodiwa se 'range,' kwete 'kukosha.'
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.d: Kunyange tisingazivi □, fananidza nzvimbo yeones: 8 yeGaram Village yakakura kupfuura 0 yeNarae Village, saka Garam Village ine vakawanda
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.d: Wakafananidza uchitanga panzvimbo yepazasi. Funga kuti nzvimbo ipi yaunofanira kutarisa kutanga kana uchifananidza nhamba hombe.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.explain: Nzvimbo yemamirioni yenhamba dzose mbiri i3, saka fananidza nzvimbo inotevera, nzvimbo yehundred-thousands. Narae Village ine 5. Kana □ i6~9, Garam Village ine vakawanda, uye kana □ i0~4, Narae Village ine vakawanda. Kana □ i5, nzvimbo dzehundred-thousands dzakaenzana, saka tarisa nzvimbo inotevera. Nzvimbo yeten-thousands i4 kuGaram Village uye 0 kuNarae Village, saka Garam Village ine vakawanda (3,545,678 > 3,500,000). Saka kunyange tisingazivi chaizvo kuti □ i chii, kuziva chete 'i4 kana pazasi, kana i5 kana kupfuura?' kwakakwana kusarudza.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.prompt: Mhedzisiro inochinja zvichienderana nedhijiti iri mu □. Uchishandisa mamiriro seye 'kana □ i ...', nyora kuti Garam Village ine vakawanda munyaya dzipi uye Narae Village ine vakawanda munyaya dzipi. Nyorawo kuti wakafananidza nzvimbo ipi kusarudza izvozvo.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nhamba ine 5 mu □ nenhamba yeNarae Village padivi nedivi, uchitanga panzvimbo yepamusoro.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga wanyora kuti musha upi une vakawanda kana □ i4 nekana □ i6.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa zvakasiyana kuti chii chinoitika kana □ i5 here?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mhinduro yako inoratidza kutevedzana here: nzvimbo yemamirioni yakaenzana, saka nzvimbo inotevera yakafananidzwa?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakaongorora nyaya dzako nekuisa madhijiti chaiwo (semuenzaniso, 2 ne7) mu □ here?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.model.0: Kana □ i5 kana nhamba huru, Garam Village ine vakawanda, uye kana □ i4 kana nhamba diki, Narae Village ine vakawanda. Nzvimbo yemamirioni i3 mune dzose, saka ndakafananidza □ munzvimbo yehundred-thousands ne5.

y-m-10-02.title: Mhinduro yaSeoa: tinogona kuvimba nayo here?
y-m-10-02.topic: Kuongorora mhedzisiro ye (nhamba yemadhijiti matatu)×(nhamba yemadhijiti maviri) (kufungidzira, ones digit, kuenzanisa nzvimbo)
y-m-10-02.goal: Pasina kuverenga zvakare, shandisa kufungidzira neones digit kuwana kuti mhinduro yakaipa, tsvaga mutsara wakaipa muchigadziriso uye utsanangure kuti nei, uye ugadzire kuwanza kwako kunopfuura kuongorora kwekukurumidza kuviri.
y-m-10-02.material: Bhuku rimwe rekunyora rinodhura 347원. Kuti awane mutengo webhuku rekunyora 23, Seoa akaita kuwanza zvakatwasuka ndokunyora mhinduro 1,735원. Unogona kuona kuverenga kwaSeoa munhanho yechipiri. Tanga, pasina kuverenga zvakare, funga kana mhinduro iyi inogona kuvimbwa.
y-m-10-02.thinking.2: Kutsvaga mutsara wekutanga apo kukanganisa kunoitika
y-m-10-02.thinking.3: Kugadzira muenzaniso wako pachako unogutsa mamiriro
y-m-10-02.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekuverenga (nhamba yemadhijiti matatu)×(nhamba yedhijiti imwe) ne (nhamba yemadhijiti maviri)×(nhamba yemadhijiti maviri)
y-m-10-02.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekufungidzira nenhamba dziri padhuze mumazana netens
y-m-10-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvaunogona kushandisa sehumbowo hwekuti mhinduro yaSeoa 1,735원 yakaipa. (Zvaunogona kuziva pasina kuverenga zvakare kubva pakutanga)
y-m-10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kana unogona kufungidzira nyore kukosha kuri padhuze nehukuru hwemhinduro yaSeoa.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kushandura 347 ne23 kuita nhamba dziri padhuze mumazana netens, kana utarise kuti chigadzirwa chemadhijiti api chinosarudza ones digit yechigadzirwa.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.a: 1,735 inhamba yemadhijiti mana uye 347×23 inoitawo seyemadhijiti mana, saka zvinoita sezvakarurama
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.a: Wakatarisa chokwadi chekuti huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakafanana chete. Nhamba dzemadhijiti mana dzinobva pa1,000 kusvika ku9,999, saka izvi hazvikwani kutonga hukuru.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.b: Kana ukatora 347 seinenge 300 ne23 seinenge 20, mhinduro inofanira kuva padhuze ne300×20=6,000, saka 1,735 idiki zvakanyanya
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.b: Wakatanga wafungidzira hukuru hwakanyanya nekushandura nhamba mbiri dziri kuwanzwa kuita nhamba dziri padhuze mumazana netens.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.c: Kana ukaverenga kamwe zvakare nenzira imwe chete ukawana kukosha kumwe chete, kwakarurama
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.c: Kana ukadzokorora nzira imwe chete, kukanganisa kumwe chete kunogona kudzokororwa. Funga nezvekuongorora nenzira yakasiyana.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.d: Sezvo 7×3=21, ones digit yechigadzirwa inofanira kuva 1, asi 1,735 inopera ne5
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.d: Wakashandisa chivakwa chekuti ones digit yechigadzirwa inosarudzwa nechigadzirwa chemaones digits.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.explain: b ne d dzinosvika pamhedziso imwe chete (haisi 1,735) nenzira dzakasiyana. b inoongorora hukuru uye d inoongorora ones digit. a inongotaura kuti huwandu hwemadhijiti hwakafanana, saka humbowo hwayo hwakaneta, uye c inogona kudzokorora kukanganisa kumwe chete. Nekufungidzira kana kuongorora ones digit unogona kuva nechokwadi kuti "yakaipa," asi kunyange ikapfuura zvose, haugoni kupedzisa kuti "yakarurama."
y-m-10-02.s.s1.acc.0: Kufungidzira koga kunoratidza kuti 1,735 idiki zvakanyanya. Kuongorora ones digit (d) ihumbowo hwakazvimirirawo.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.acc.1: Ones digit yoga inoratidza kuti yakaipa. Kufungidzira kunotarisa hukuru (b) humwe humbowo.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.prompt: Verenga chigadziriso chaSeoa mutsara nemutsara. Mutsara upi ndiwo wekutanga wakaipa?
y-m-10-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa imwe nenguva kana kuwanza nekuwedzera kwemutsara wega wega kwakarurama.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.hint.1: Mumutsara wega wega, nyora kuti nhamba yakawanzwa inoreva chii chaizvo, uye ufananidze kuti nzvimbo dzakaenzanisirwa sei kana uchiwedzera zvigadzirwa izvozvo.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.line.0: Wanza ne ones digit 3 kutanga. 347 × 3 = 1041, saka nyora 1041 pamutsara wekutanga.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.line.1: Wanza nenhamba yemakumi 2. 347 × 2 = 694, saka nyora 694 pamutsetse wechipiri, wakaenzanisa nomugumo wokuruboshwe womutsetse wekutanga.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.explain: Kukanganisa kwekutanga kuri pamutsetse 2. 2 mu 23 inhamba yemakumi, saka inoreva 20, uye unofanira kuwedzera 347×20=6940. Kana ukanyora 694 wakaenzanisa nomugumo wokuruboshwe, unowedzera 694, kwete 6940. Kuwedzera pamutsetse 3 kwakarurama pachako, asi nhamba mbiri dzinowedzerwa dzakanganisa, uye nokudaro mhedzisiro pamutsetse 4 yakanganisawo. Mhinduro chaiyo ndi 1041 + 6940 = 7981.
y-m-10-02.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira kuwanza kuviri kune zvakawanikwa zvakasiyana kunopfuura kufungidzira (chakawanikwa chiri 6,000 kana kupfuura uye 8,000 kana kushoma) nokutarisa nhamba yeimwe (chakawanikwa chinopera ne 1). Nhamba inowanzwa a inhamba ine mapoka matatu uye nhamba inowanza b inhamba ine mapoka maviri. 347×23 yakatoshandiswa, saka usaishandise.
y-m-10-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nhamba yeimwe yechakawanikwa ndiyo imwe neyechakawanikwa chenhamba dzeimwe dzenhamba mbiri idzi. Tsvaga mapeya enhamba anoita kuti kukosha uku kuve 1.

y-m-10-03.title: Mabhokisi emaapuro 200
y-m-10-03.topic: Kududzira mhinduro nokusara kwekuparadzanisa nokusara kuti kuenderane nemamiriro
y-m-10-03.goal: Nzwisisa kuti mhinduro nokusara zvimwe chete zvinoshandiswa semhinduro dzakasiyana kana mubvunzo wachinja, uye, nokugadzira nhamba dzinogoneka dzekuparadzanisa kune mhinduro nokusara zvakapihwa, tarisa mamiriro okuti 'chasara chiri chidiki kupfuura muparadzanisi.'
y-m-10-03.material: Chitoro chemichero chine maapuro 200. Bhokisi rimwe rinogona kutakura maapuro 12 zvakanyanya. 200 yakaparadzanwa ne 12 inopa mhinduro 16 uye chasara 8 (12×16=192 uye 200-192=8).
y-m-10-03.thinking.0: Kuchinja kana kuramba wakasarudza zvichienderana nemamiriro matsva
y-m-10-03.thinking.1: Kududzira mhedzisiro imwe chete yekuverenga kuti ienderane nemamiriro
y-m-10-03.thinking.2: Kugadzira mhinduro dzakati wandei dzinosangana nemamiriro
y-m-10-03.prereq.0: Chirevo chemhinduro nechasara mu (nhamba ine mapoka matatu)÷(nhamba ine mapoka maviri)
y-m-10-03.s.s1.prompt: Tevera, uchiwana ruzivo rumwe panguva imwe, kuti uone kuti mhedzisiro imwe chete yekuverenga (mhinduro 16, chasara 8) inoshandiswa sei zvichienderana nomubvunzo.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva dzose kana ruzivo rwapiwa, tsanangura nemazwi kuti maapuro 8 ari kupi.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kana mhinduro yega yega yakarurama, tarisa kuti pane maapuro mangani zvose nokuwanza ne 12.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Muridzi akati, "Ndinoda kuisa maapuro mumabhokisi ndigoaichengeta." Hapana chimwe chakataurwa parizvino.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mabhokisi mangani anodiwa? Sarudza pfungwa yako yeparizvino.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana ukaverenga "aise mumabhokisi uchengete" sokureva kuisa ose, ndi mabhokisi 17, uye pfungwa yokutanga kutarisa kuti maapuro 8 ange aitwa sei inonyatsonzwisisika. Mabhokisi 16 mhinduro isingaise maapuro 8 paripi.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakanyora mhinduro chete semhinduro uye haina kufunga kuti maapuro 8 asara anoitwei.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Mabhokisi 17. Maapuro 8 asara anofanira kuiswawo, saka rinodikanwa bhokisi rimwe rakawedzerwa
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaverenga kuti maapuro 8 asara anoiswawo mubhokisi.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hazvigoni kusarudzwa. Tinofanira kuziva kuti maapuro 8 asara anoitwei
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Muridzi akawedzera, "Ndinogona kutengesa kuvatengi mabhokisi azara chete ane maapuro 12."
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Saka mabhokisi mangani anogona kutengeswa kuvatengi?
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Pane mabhokisi 16 azara, uye maapuro 8 akasara nokuti haakwanisi kuzadza bhokisi. Pamubvunzo uyu, mhinduro 16 ndiyo mhinduro.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Mabhokisi 17. Bhokisi rine maapuro asara rinogonawo kutengeswa
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Hauna kushandisa mamiriro matsva awakangonzwa, 'mabhokisi azara chete.'
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Mabhokisi 16. Mabhokisi azara chete ndiwo anoverengwa, saka akaenzana nemhinduro
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakaisa mamiriro okuti 'mabhokisi azara' chete ndiwo anoverengwa.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waverenga chasara 8 sehuwandu hwemabhokisi. Chasara ihuwandu hwemaapuro asara.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Muridzi akachinja pfungwa. "Ngatisarasire maapuro asara; ngatiaise ose mumabhokisi totaichengeta mudura. Bhokisi rimwe rinogona kutakura maapuro 12 zvakanyanya."
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mabhokisi mangani achachengetwa mudura, uye pane maapuro mangani mubhokisi rokupedzisira?
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Pamabhokisi 17, 16 ane maapuro 12 rimwe nerimwe, ari 192, uye bhokisi rokupedzisira rine maapuro 8 asara (192+8=200). Kuzadza mabhokisi ose 17 zvizere waizoda maapuro 12×17=204, saka waizoshaya maapuro 4.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hauna kusarudza kuti maapuro 8 asara anoiswa kupi.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waverenga huwandu hwemabhokisi zvakanaka, asi tarisa kuti paizova nemaapuro mangani dai mabhokisi ose 17 akazadzwa zvizere.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, b ne c dzose dzaiva dzinonzwisisika (nokuti hatizivi kuti maapuro 8 aizoitwei). Zvichienderana nemamiriro matsva, mhinduro yakava 16 kana 17. Kunyange nemhedzisiro imwe chete yekuverenga, zvichienderana nokuti mubvunzo uri pamusoro pe 'azara chete' kana 'ose,' unoshandisa mhinduro sezvayakaita kana kuwedzera 1 kumhinduro.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, ngatifungei shure. Nhamba ine mapoka matatu a yakaparadzanwa nenhamba ine mapoka maviri b, uye mhinduro yaiva 15 uye chasara chaiva 17 (kuparadzanisa: a ÷ b = 15 … 17). Gadzira mapeya maviri e a ne b akadaro, ane kukosha kwakasiyana kwa b.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyorazve "mhinduro ndi 15 uye chasara ndi 17" se "b inopinda nguva dzakati wandei uye pane chinosara," uye unyore chirevo che a uchishandisa b. Wobva wasarudza nhamba imwe yokushandisa kuna b uye ugadzire a.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Paraadzanisa chaizvo a yawagadzira ne b kuti utarise kuti unowana mhinduro 15 nechasara 17, uye uenzanise chasara na b.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c3: a haisi nhamba yaunowana nokuwedzera 17 ku b×15. Edza kuvaka a shure kubva pamhinduro nechasara.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Chasara 17 chikuru kupfuura kana kuenzana nomuparadzanisi b. Kana ukaparadzanisa chaizvo muchirevo ichi, mhinduro nechasara zvinochinja.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.explain: a ndi b×15+17. Semuenzaniso, kana b=20 saka a=317, uye 317÷20 inopa mhinduro 15 nechasara 17. Asi, chasara chinofanira kuva chidiki kupfuura muparadzanisi, saka b inofanira kuva yakakura kupfuura 17, uye kuti a ive nhamba ine mapoka matatu, b inofanira kuva 65 kana kushoma. Saka nhamba yechisikigo b ipi neipi kubva pa 18 kusvika pa 65 inoshanda.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.prompt: Minho akasarudza b=12 ne a=197 uye akanyora "197 ÷ 12 = 15 … 17". Nyora kuti sei chirevo ichi chisingagoni kuva mhedzisiro yakarurama yekuparadzanisa, uye unyore mhinduro nechasara chaiyo kana 197 yaparadzanwa ne 12.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa nhamba yasara mushure mokubvisa 12 kubva ku 197 nguva 15 ne 12.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana unogona kubvisa 12 imwe nguva kubva panhamba yasara, wobva wanyora kuti mhinduro nechasara zvinochinja sei.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti 12 inopinda nguva dzingani dzakawanda muchasara 17?
y-m-10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here mhinduro nechasara chaiyo ne 12×(mhinduro)+(chasara)=197?
y-m-10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora here nemashoko ako kuti sei chasara chinofanira kuva chidiki kupfuura muparadzanisi?
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.0: Zvakadaro nokuti chasara 17 chikuru kupfuura muparadzanisi 12. 12 inopinda muna 17 imwe nguva, saka kana ukaita 197÷12 chaizvo, mhinduro ndi 16 uye chasara ndi 5.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.1: Nhamba inosara mushure mokuparadzanisa ne 12 inofanira kuva diki kupfuura 12, asi 17 ndiyo yasara, saka unogona kuparadzanisa imwe nguva. Saka 197 = 12×16 + 5.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Inoshandisa 'nhamba yasara' pachinzvimbo chezwi rokuti 'chasara,' asi inoreva chinhu chimwe chete.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.2: 17 yakakura kupfuura 12, saka 12 inogona kubviswa imwe nguva, zvichireva kuti zvakanganisa. 197÷12 ine mhinduro 16 nechasara 5.

y-m-10-04.title: Zvikamu zvine muparadzanisi 7 zvine chikamu chenhamba yose chiri 2
y-m-10-04.topic: Hukama hwezvikamu zvakakura zvakapetwa nenhamba dzakasanganiswa dzine muparadzanisi mumwe chete (kutsvaga zvikamu zvakakura zvine chikamu chenhamba yose chimwe chete)
y-m-10-04.goal: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro yechikamu nokufungidzira (kuenzanisa hukuru), tsvaga nhamba dzose dziri pamusoro dzinosangana nemamiriro, uye uzivise kuti pane muenzaniso upi. Tsanangura kuti sei mamiriro okumigumo anova nhamba dzose asingaverengwi senhamba dzakasanganiswa.
y-m-10-04.material: Chikamu chakarurama chikamu chine nhamba iri pamusoro diki kupfuura iri pasi, chikamu chakakura chikamu chine nhamba iri pamusoro yakaenzana kana kukura kupfuura iri pasi, uye nhamba yakasanganiswa nhamba ine nhamba yose nechikamu chakarurama pamwe chete (muenzaniso: 2 ne 3/7). Chikamu chinobuda chiri nhamba yose chaiyo, se 14/7, inhamba yose, kwete nhamba yakasanganiswa. Mubasa iri, nhamba iri pamusoro yechikamu inhamba yechisikigo.
y-m-10-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inosangana nemamiriro
y-m-10-04.thinking.3: Kufunga nezvemutemo wokuverenga kana muparadzanisi achichinja
y-m-10-04.prereq.0: Mazita nezvirevo zvezvikamu zvakarurama, zvikamu zvakakura, nenhamba dzakasanganiswa (nhanho yeGiredhi 4)
y-m-10-04.prereq.1: Kuedza kushandura nhamba yose kuva chikamu chine muparadzanisi mumwe chete
y-m-10-04.s.s1.prompt: Hangyeol akanyora mhinduro yokushandura '3 ne 2/5' kuva chikamu chakakura. Mutsetse upi wekutanga wakanganisa?
y-m-10-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wafunga kuti ndeipi yakakura, 3 ne 2/5 kana 3, uye uienzanise nemhedzisiro yokupedzisira yemhinduro.
y-m-10-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga watarisa kuti nhamba yose 1 chikamu chipi chine muparadzanisi 5.
y-m-10-04.s.s1.line.0: Ngatinyoreiwo nhamba yose 3 mu 3 ne 2/5 sechikamu chine muparadzanisi 5.
y-m-10-04.s.s1.line.3: Saka 3 ne 2/5 yakaenzana ne 5/5, ndiko kuti, 1.
y-m-10-04.s.s1.explain: Kukanganisa kwekutanga kuri pamutsetse 2. 1 ndi 5/5, saka 3 ndi 15/5. 3/5 idiki kupfuura 1, saka haigoni kuenzana ne 3. Mhedzisiro iri pamutsetse 4 yakanganisawo, nokuti 3 ne 2/5 yakakura kupfuura 3 asi yakanyorwa 1. Mhinduro chaiyo ndeyokuwedzera 15/5 ne 2/5 kuti uwane 17/5.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.prompt: Pakati pezvikamu zvakakura zvine muparadzanisi 7, tsvaga zvikamu 3 zvine chikamu chenhamba yose chiri 2 kana zvakanyorwa senhamba dzakasanganiswa, uye unyore nhamba dzazvo dziri pamusoro. y-m-10-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kubva patafura, sarudza mitsetse chete apo chikamu chenhamba yose chiri 2, enzanisa nhamba dziri pamusoro, uye utarisewo kana chikamu chakarurama chasara.

y-m-10-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana nhamba iri pamusoro iri shoma pa 7, chikamu chakarurama. Chiite chikamu chakakura.

y-m-10-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Ine chikamu chakarurama, saka inhamba yakasanganiswa.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Inhamba inobuda iri nhamba yose chaiyo. Sarudza nhamba iri pamusoro inosiya chikamu chakarurama.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.explain: 14/7 inhamba yose 2, uye 21/7 ndi 3. Nhamba dzakasanganiswa dzine chikamu chenhamba yose 2 ndi 2 ne 1/7 kusvika 2 ne 6/7, uye kana dzashandurwa kuva zvikamu zvakakura, pane 6, dzine nhamba dziri pamusoro 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino muparadzanisi ndi 9. Kana zvakanyorwa senhamba dzakasanganiswa, zvikamu zvakakura zvingani zvine chikamu chenhamba yose che 2?
y-m-10-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kana muparadzanisi ari 9, nyora nhamba dzose dzinogona kuiswa mu □ munhamba yakasanganiswa 2 ne □/9.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti unowana nhamba ipi kana □ iri 0 kana 9, uye usarudze kuti unosanganisa nyaya idzi mbiri here.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.r.a: Wakafunga kuti huwandu hwemuparadzanisi 7 hunoramba hwakafanana. Tarisa nokunyora iwe pachako nhamba dziri pamusoro dzemuparadzanisi 9.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.r.b: Wakasanganisa nhamba iri pamusoro 18. Tarisa kana 18/9 inhamba yose kana nhamba yakasanganiswa.

y-m-10-04.s.s3.r.d: Iyi ipfungwa yokuverenga pasina migumo miviri, inobuda iri nhamba dzose chaidzo.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.explain: Nhamba dzakasanganiswa dzine chikamu chenhamba yose 2 ndi 2 ne 1/9 kusvika 2 ne 8/9, iri 8. Kana dzashandurwa kuva zvikamu zvakakura, nhamba dziri pamusoro ndi 19 kusvika 26. 18/9 ndi 2 uye 27/9 ndi 3, saka hazvisi nhamba dzakasanganiswa. Huwandu ndi 6 kana muparadzanisi ari 7 uye 8 kana ari 9, saka huwandu hwakaenzana ne (muparadzanisi - 1). Izvi zvinoitika nokuti nhamba iri pamusoro yechikamu chakarurama inogona kuva chero ipi kubva pa 1 kusvika pa (muparadzanisi - 1).

y-m-10-06.title: Marekodhi emwedzi mitatu anogona kutiudza mwedzi unotevera here?
y-m-10-06.topic: Kuverenga nekutsvedza nenhamba hombe nemiganhu yekufungidzira nemutemo
y-m-10-06.goal: Fungidzira nhamba inotevera kubva pa rekodhi inotsvedza ne 100,000, asi ratidza nemuenzaniso unopokana kuti marekodhi mashoma haagone kuita 'zvechokwadi' kuva saizvozvo, uye usiyanise fungidziro nechokwadi.
y-m-10-06.material: Amusement park yakanyora huwandu hwevashanyi mwedzi mumwe nemumwe. Marekodhi akanyorwa muzvikamu zve 10,000 vanhu chete, saka anogara ari ma multiples e 10,000. Ndira i vanhu 3,420,000, Kukadzi i vanhu 3,520,000, uye Kurume i vanhu 3,620,000. Mina akati, “Iri kukwira ne vanhu 100,000 pamwedzi, saka Kubvumbi zvechokwadi chichava vanhu 3,720,000!”
y-m-10-06.thinking.0: Kutonga kuti fungidziro inovakirwa pamutemo yakasimba zvakadini
y-m-10-06.thinking.2: Kunyora fungidziro nechirevo chakasimba sezvinhu zvakasiyana
y-m-10-06.prereq.0: Kuverenga nekunyora nhamba hombe muzvikamu zve hundred-thousands ne millions (4th-grade level)
y-m-10-06.s.s1.prompt: Ndeipi pfungwa yakakodzera zvikuru nezvakataurwa naMina?
y-m-10-06.s.s1.hint.0: Wana kuti vakakwira ne vanhu vangani kubva Ndira kuenda Kukadzi nekubva Kukadzi kuenda Kurume.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.hint.1: Funga mamiriro mamwe apo Kubvumbi kwaigona kuva nemutengo wakasiyana (semuenzaniso, mamiriro ekunze kana chiitiko), uye funga kana marekodhi oga angakuudza izvozvo.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.a: Anenge vanhu 3,720,000 i fungidziro yakajairika, asi mutengo wakasiyana ungabuda
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga mutemo kubva pamarekodhi uye wakasiyanisawo fungidziro nechokwadi.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.b: Vanhu 3,720,000 zvechokwadi i zvakarurama. Nekuti yakakwira ne 100,000 pamwedzi mitatu yose
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.b: Kubva pachokwadi chekuti yakafanana ka3, wakapedza kuti inogara iri saizvozvo. Funga kana pane humbowo hwekuti ichafanana nguva yechina zvakare.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.c: Kubvumbi hakugone kuzivikanwa zvachose. Marekodhi matatu ekutanga haana basa pakufungidzira
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakarasa marekodhi ose apfuura. Funga kana ari chiratidzo chemutemo.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.d: Zvinoratidzika kuti ichava anenge vanhu 3,620,000, asi inogona kukanganisa
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.d: Wakataura nekungwarira, asi hauna kushandisa huwandu hwekuwedzera hunogona kuverengwa kubva pamarekodhi.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.explain: Kuti yakakwira ne 100,000 mumwedzi mitatu i chiratidzo chekuti inogona kukwira nehuwandu hwakafanana muna Kubvumbi zvakare. Asi huwandu hwekuwedzera muna Kubvumbi hunogona kusiyana, saka haugone kutaura 'zvechokwadi'. Kurasa marekodhi ose (c) kana kuregeredza huwandu hwekuwedzera (d) hazvisi fungidziro yakanakawo.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira marekodhi anoratidza kuti 'zvechokwadi' yaMina inogona kuva isina kururama. Muna Ndira, Kukadzi, ne Kurume nhamba inokwira ne 100,000 imwe neimwe, uye muna Kubvumbi haisi 100,000 yakawanda kupfuura yaKurume. y-m-10-06.s.s2.hint.0: Chengeta mwedzi mitatu yekutanga seyakaita muenzaniso, uye funga mutengo waKubvumbi usiri 100,000 yakawanda kupfuura yaKurume.

y-m-10-06.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, 3,420,000 → 3,520,000 → 3,620,000 → 3,730,000 yakakwira ne 100,000 mumwedzi mitatu yekutanga uye ipapo yakakwira ne 110,000 muna Kubvumbi. Rekodhi inodzikira, sa 5,100,000 → 5,200,000 → 5,300,000 → 5,250,000, i counterexample zvakare. Kana kunyange rekodhi rimwe rakadaro rinogoneka, marekodhi emwedzi mitatu oga haagone kuita Kubvumbi 'zvechokwadi' chimwe chinhu.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.prompt: Ungafungidzira sei huwandu hwevanhu muna Kubvumbi? Nyora nhamba yako yawafungidzira nechikonzero, uye unyorewo zvaunofanira kuziva zvakawanda kubatsira kana fungidziro yako ingakanganisa.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.hint.0: Isa marekodhi awakagadzira mu s2 padivi pemarekodhi matatu ekutanga, uye uone kuti Kubvumbi kwaigona kusiyana sei kubva pamarekodhi amwechete kusvika Kurume.

y-m-10-06.s.s3.model.0: Ndinofungidzira kuti Kubvumbi kuchava anenge vanhu 3,720,000. Izvi nekuti yakakwira ne 100,000 mwedzi wega wega kubva Ndira kusvika Kurume. Asi zviitiko kana mamiriro ekunze muna Kubvumbi zvingava zvakasiyana, saka ndaizoda kuziva zvakawanda nezvizvozvo kuti nditonge.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.model.1: Ndinofungidzira anenge vanhu 3,720,000, asi handigone kutaura kuti zvechokwadi i izvozvo. Zvechokwadi kuti huwandu hwakafanana hwakawedzerwa mumwedzi mitatu, asi Kubvumbi kungava kwakachinja zvakasiyana. Dai ndaiva nerekodhi raChivabvu, ndaigona kuvimba nemutemo zvakawanda.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Hazviiti kuti fungidziro ive chirevo chakasimba, uye inotaura zvakajeka kuti marekodhi ekuwedzera api anodiwa.
